name: custom138k-workstation-v1
purpose: F01 explicit source checkpoint for the complete-workstation migration; not a release or acceptance

features.name: usb_midi
features.selected_behavior: A2 HS/FS transport, production firmware and native input owner selected; Push/25K alternate on one port
features.remaining: I01: integrated enumeration, hotplug, session/PANIC and real audio acceptance

features.name: synthesis_ABC_vector
features.selected_behavior: Native session/parameters/DSP composition; 18-bit events and global PANIC preserved
features.remaining: A01/A05: full load timing and real performance

features.name: effects
features.selected_behavior: Delay, Chorus and spatial Reverb retained through the resource parent
features.remaining: A02/A07: both sample rates, quality and timing

features.name: audio_48k_i2s
features.selected_behavior: 12.288 MHz reference, I2S 32-bit slots and final master gain in FPC output
features.remaining: A03/A04: common final PCM/taps, real stereo output and clock budgets

features.name: audio_44k1_switch
features.selected_behavior: Second hardware oscillator is a confirmed premise; this checkpoint has no runtime rate switch
features.remaining: F03/A06/A07: pin/clock qualification, safe selection, DSP and format negotiation

features.name: hdmi_ddr
features.selected_behavior: Shared scanout and versioned HDMI composition with native scan-window admission for new CPU/raster/snapshot writes; accepted tails and realtime clients retained
features.remaining: D01/D03/D04/F04: bounded all-client service, atomic frame ownership, physical deadlines and hardware contention

features.name: fpga_visuals
features.selected_behavior: Existing FPGA analysis/rendering and DDR scanout preserved
features.remaining: D02/D03: remaining plots, final tap and atomic per-output buffers

features.name: usb_display
features.selected_behavior: Existing Push pixels and 25K Host tile rendering retained
features.remaining: D05/D06: committed DDR pixel consumption and slow-end isolation

features.name: ae350
features.selected_behavior: AE350 UI/services C, headers, startup and linker script rebuilt into candidate boot.mem with tool, ELF, ROM and capacity evidence
features.remaining: C01-C05: bounded business services, whole-call-chain stack and hardware acceptance

features.name: ble_short_recording
features.selected_behavior: Existing business transport and post-FPC 48 kHz PCM16 capture; 16384-frame RAM capacity
features.remaining: B01/R01: nonzero real audio, Android and AE350 business ownership

features.name: long_recording_ddr
features.selected_behavior: No new DDR recording allocation or capability is claimed
features.remaining: R00/R02-R04: storage, immutable objects, reliable download and device testing

features.name: tf_playback
features.selected_behavior: Existing TF WAV/DDR banks and independent audio route preserved
features.remaining: M03/A03: bounded streaming without DDR playback staging and explicit rate policy

features.name: recognition_guidance
features.selected_behavior: Explicit live CNN resource candidate and existing Push guidance; no accepted CNN promotion
features.remaining: M01/M02: model cold boot, recognition and concurrent playback acceptance

features.name: D_sampler
features.selected_behavior: Independent sampler source is retained, not selected as a complete-workstation source

features.name: lcd_touch
features.selected_behavior: LCD consumes shared snapshot; no touch input selected
features.remaining: D07: final product scope and hardware acceptance

features.name: wifi
features.selected_behavior: Wi-Fi is held disabled in this composition
features.remaining: B03: product scope and vertical integration

A2.scope: Push HS enumeration, unplug/replug recovery and MIDI reception on headless 138K probe

D5.scope: User-accepted standalone 1080p display and DDR path; no AE350 in this configuration

C1.scope: BLE business GATT, reconnect, short recording and CRC download; historical captured PCM was all zero
